scenarios.name: Launch a command through a left-docked compact group key tip

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left
Modify is displayed as a compact group button
the user presses Alt
key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls
the 3D Model tab displays the key tip "M"
the user presses "M"
key tips appear on the visible 3D Model commands and compact groups
the Modify group displays the key tip "Y"
the user presses "Y"
the adjacent Modify command panel opens
its commands display key tips including "HO" for Hole
the user presses "H"
the displayed command key tips narrow to matching H-prefixed entries
the user presses "O"
the Hole properties panel opens
the ribbon key tips and adjacent Modify panel disappear
the user clicks Cancel in the Hole properties panel
the properties panel closes without creating a hole
the ribbon remains docked on the left
